description: A self-hosted server, built on ClickHouse, that gives AI agents shared long-term memory, document search and a code index. Agents reach it over MCP, HTTP and the Python (clickhouse-loom) and TypeScript (@clickhouse/loom) SDKs.
rules: Every operation is one HTTP endpoint, POST /v1/<operation>. Most are also MCP tools at <server>/mcp, named loom_ plus the operation name with dots as underscores (memory.set is loom_memory_set); search.query is loom_search. An operation the tool list does not show runs through loom_op with {op, arguments}.
A call carries a JWT whose org and namespaces scope what it can read and write; a server started with auth off, such as a single-user server on loopback, accepts calls without one.
A memory is one claim stored under a readable key in a namespace: write it with memory.set, and find it with loom_search over MCP or memory.search and search.query over HTTP and the SDKs.
Use the code.* operations for questions about an indexed repository instead of reading whole files.
